# Tennessee — Atlas Normalization Change Log

## Normalization procedure

- `evidence.md` was normalized to the required `Evidence Layer` contract with structural exclusions, evidence gaps, and required closing status lines.
- `signals.md` was constrained to evidence-derived outputs only.
- `trust-dimensions.md` was limited to interpretive posture signals only.
- `profile.md` was aligned to jurisdiction-lens framing only.
- `builder-mode.md` was reduced to scenario scaffolding only.
- Placeholder-only Tennessee files were replaced with contract-aligned skeletal layer files without introducing new Tennessee claims.

## Structural exclusions

Structural exclusions were documented so that unsupported routing, spillover, ranking, readiness, and surface-assignment claims remain excluded.

## Gap inheritance

Evidence gaps were established in `evidence.md` and carried forward into downstream Tennessee layers without inference expansion.

## Lens alignment confirmation

Tennessee package framing was kept structure-only and evidence-first. No new Tennessee evidence claims were introduced during normalization.

## Normalization adjustments

- standardized all six layer files to the Kansas-reference contract shape
- replaced placeholder files with contract-aligned structure-only content
- preserved evidence absence as a valid normalized outcome
- enforced surface neutrality and non-assignment constraints across downstream layers

## Normalization update (Atlas contract alignment)

Confirmed:

Evidence-layer structure normalized
Signals constrained to evidence-derived outputs
Trust-dimensions limited to interpretive posture signals
Profile aligned to jurisdiction-lens framing
Builder-mode reduced to scenario scaffolding role
Structural exclusions documented
Evidence gaps preserved without inference
Surface neutrality enforced

Tennessee package now conforms to Kansas reference template.
